rationale: The workflow already caches npm dependencies via actions/setup-node@v6 with cache: npm, satisfying P-LIT-GHA-CACHE's dependency-caching intent; adding a separate actions/cache step would be redundant because an equivalent cache already exists (a listed contraindication). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a GitHub Pages deployment workflow (release/deployment work), and the existing concurrency block already preserves in-progress runs with cancel-in-progress: false. P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW lacks the required repository-policy precondition and would reduce deployment coverage on master. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER is risky for a deployment workflow where every master push should deploy, and shared docs configuration could affect supposedly unrelated paths. No matrix exists for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, no schedule exists for P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE, no tests are run in this workflow for test-selection/prioritization patterns, and it is not a Bazel project. No supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or violating a contraindication.
